name: MolmoAct2
summary: MolmoAct2 is an open-weight action reasoning model built on MolmoER, a vision-language backbone trained on 3.3M embodied reasoning samples. Around it AI2 released the pieces a VLA normally keeps private: three datasets including what they describe as the largest open bimanual corpus to date at 720 hours of teleoperated trajectories, and OpenFAST, an open-weight action tokenizer trained across multiple robot platforms. MolmoThink adds adaptive-depth reasoning that cuts latency by thinking less on easy steps while holding performance. Weights, training code and the complete training data are all released.
innovation: An open counterpart to the closed FAST tokenizer, trained across platforms and released with weights.
Adaptive-depth reasoning that spends inference compute only where the step is hard.
Full-stack openness — weights, code and training data — at a scale usually reserved for closed releases.
matters: The most completely reproducible VLA release of the year, and the largest open bimanual dataset, which is the format most dexterous work now needs.
limits: Reasoning-model latency remains high relative to plain action-chunked policies even with adaptive depth.
Bimanual corpus is teleoperated on specific platforms, so it carries their kinematics.
lineage: Molmo's grounding and pointing work turned into an action model, with the tokenizer and data opened alongside.
